red_team_issues: CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: All three scanners read 'manifest.get(total_tokens, 0)' from the top level, but the real mission_archiver format stores tokens nested under 'totals.total_tokens'. This caused 100% false-positive zero-token detection on all 125 real mission archives.
SECONDARY BUG FOUND AND FIXED: 'manifest.get(totals, {})' does not handle totals=null in JSON (returns None, not {}). Fixed to 'manifest.get(totals) or {}' in all three components.
property_violations: totals=null JSON crashes scanner with AttributeError on .get() — fixed with 'or {}' pattern
Empty manifest {} correctly falls back to zero_token — no violation
totals dict present but missing total_tokens key correctly falls back to 0 — no violation
